findings.identity_explanation: Tag LIFT-01 matches exactly in CR, ES, FM:TFM-0301, COM-08 and WAR-08. Model VX-1600 and location Core A agree wherever stated; serial VX16-7101 agrees in CR, COM-08 and WAR-08 (not stated in ES or FM). No possible tag matches were found.

exceptions.finding: COM-08 line 11 shows Final approval: Signed for LIFT-01, but the Arabic remark on line 19 says LIFT-01 was tested but the consultant's final signature has not yet been issued. Under Evidence 2.1 a remark cannot override a field, so both are reported as a conflict. No source settles whether the final approval was actually signed. LIFT-01 is a life-safety asset, so any open exception is critical (Readiness 3.1).

findings.summary: Code found no exceptions and the rule-based status is Ready for review, but COM-08 contradicts itself on LIFT-01: the field says Final approval: Signed while the Arabic remark says the consultant's final signature has not yet been issued. LIFT-01 is a life-safety asset, so this open conflict is critical and I recommend Not ready for acceptance, which is stricter than the rule result. I cannot tell from the sources which statement is right, so this goes to the FM handover manager.
findings.escalate_to: FM handover manager (consulting the FM operations manager for life-safety)
findings.escalation_reason: Life-safety asset (lift) with an open exception (Escalation 2.1), and evidence conflicts with no source settling it (Escalation 2.3): COM-08 field says Signed, remark says the final signature has not been issued. The manager must decide whether to approve a clarification request to the contractor and how to treat the commissioning evidence meanwhile.
findings.clarification_subject: LIFT-01 commissioning certificate COM-08: final approval status to confirm
findings.clarification_body:
Dear Project Manager,

Commissioning certificate COM-08 (Vertica Lifts, test date 2026-10-06) lists LIFT-01 with 'Final approval: Signed'. The Arabic remark on line 19 of the same certificate states that LIFT-01 was tested but the consultant's final signature has not yet been issued. These two statements conflict.

Please ask Vertica Lifts to confirm in writing whether the consultant's final approval for LIFT-01 has been signed, and to provide the signed approval or a corrected certificate. A statement that it will follow is not sufficient.

Regards,
FM Handover Team, Tessmar Facility Services
(Draft for FM handover manager approval)
uncertainties: Whether the consultant's final signature for LIFT-01 has actually been issued is unknown.
The consultant's name and any signature date are not stated in COM-08.
Serial is not stated in ES or FM:TFM-0301, so it is compared only across CR, COM-08 and WAR-08.
